author: Vusumuzi Mabasa
analysis_population: All 6000 synthetic pregnancies ongoing at the start of gestational week 20
primary_exposure: Mean daily maximum temperature during the 14 completed days before week 20
primary_outcome: Generated delivery before week 37; 0 no event through week 36, 1 event during weeks 20 to 36
adjustment: log one plus mean rainfall over the same 14 days
primary_inference: Frequentist logistic regression with HC3 sandwich standard errors and two-sided 95% Wald confidence intervals
sensitivity: natural cubic splines with 3 degrees of freedom for heat and age
omit the 5 highest Cook distances as influence sensitivity only
missing_data: Report observed missingness; complete records for the specified model; never manufacture missingness or impute generator-only truth
scope: Applied association analysis in R; public ERA5 weather and synthetic health outcomes; no method performance experiment or posterior estimates
